_comment: Hand-maintained rules. partHiddenBy: a part with this layer name is hidden when any OTHER worn item declares that slot code (the codes are the game's own, Base/smap.img: Hd head, Fc face, H1/H2/Hb hair layers and Hs the hair shade (the codes H3-H6 and Hf are the back-view layers, see AGENTS.md), Af face accessory, Ay eye decoration, Ae earrings). zFallback: layer names missing from the game's zmap, drawn as the named layer instead. useEarlierId: when a hair/face name matches several items, keep only the one with the lowest id. listFirst: wearable ids shown first in their tab, in this order (none now). upcomingExclude: dyeable items left out of the possible-upcoming list on purpose (scripts/extract-upcoming.mjs skips them): the Green, Blue and Orange Skull Overalls, which look like Halloween items but were not in the Halloween crate. baseBody: the starter undergarments drawn as part of the body by gender, taken out of the Top and Bottom tabs (catalog.base). holds: weapons that have both a one-handed and a two-handed hold in the game files (the hammer and the slingshot, class 30), so the colour panel offers a Hold choice. stand2Only: weapons with no standing pose, drawn with the whole body in the two-handed pose. exclude: styles left out of the catalogue.
